metadata.description: Personal collection of Claude Code skills and plugins.

plugins.name: zenify-my-terminal
plugins.description: Set up a fast, calm, focused terminal on macOS. Two modes — guided (walks through every choice between WezTerm/Ghostty/cmux/Alacritty/Kitty/iTerm2/Apple Terminal, Starship/Oh My Posh with live theme preview, plugins, optional extras) or fast-track (zero questions, fully coordinated Catppuccin Macchiato stack: WezTerm + JetBrainsMono Nerd Font + Catppuccin Macchiato + OMP catppuccin.omp.json rounded-pill prompt + zinit turbo + git/sudo/aws/kubectl + project switcher + viddy + lazygit + git-aware status bar + tmux with claude-team launcher + imgpaste image-paste workaround + Shift+Enter newline via kitty keyboard protocol). When ~/.claude/ is detected, also installs a custom catppuccin-macchiato statusline (model + context bar + rate limits + worktree + effort) and merges teammateMode=tmux into settings.json. Writes configs with macOS gotchas already handled. Ends with a keyboard-shortcuts cheat-sheet.

plugins.name: intent
plugins.description: Turn a rough idea into a standard intent — What / Why / Guardrails / Done means — via a layered interview: high-level gaps first, deeper only when you agree (with a recommendation either way). Output is a self-contained prompt to hand to an agent or file.

plugins.name: surface-skills
plugins.description: Map any project into per-surface agent skills: one skill per client/backend with launch, health check, drive and cleanup; a features map; a README per feature (user POV, keys, API, code, verify, debug, gotchas); and a drift check that fails the build when the map goes stale.
